idea-plugin.name: SPHIOR CODE
idea-plugin.description:
SPHIOR CODE — deterministic secrets + insecure-pattern (CWE) detection with tamper-evident audit evidence, right in your JetBrains IDE.

  • No AI, no source upload. Detection is 100% deterministic and runs locally via a bundled language server. Your code never leaves your machine.
  • Same engine as SPHIOR's service. The detection engine here is the one SPHIOR runs server-side, so what you see in the IDE matches what a connected repository reports. The plugin itself is entirely local — connecting a repository to SPHIOR is optional and separate.
  • Fix with your own AI. SPHIOR hands findings to your existing AI assistant over MCP — it does not generate code for you.

Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript (+ JSX/TSX), Python, Go, PHP, Ruby, Java, C#, Rust, Kotlin, C, C++, Scala, Swift — analysed with real parsers (tree-sitter), not just regex.

Requires Node.js on PATH (or set SPHIOR_NODE_PATH). Depends on the LSP4IJ plugin.
